claims.quote: The slender rainbowfish, Melanotaenia gracilis, is a small rainbowfish from the Drysdale and Carson Rivers in the Kimberley, north-western Australia.
This uniquely-shaped rainbow is an uncommonly seen species in the hobby, mainly because it hails from such a remote area in Australia.

regions.quote: So far, it has been recorded only from the Drysdale and Carson Rivers in the Kimberley area.
